communityLists.pageTitle: Routing Policy and BGP Community Reference
communityLists.backgroundText1: Angola Cables is a multinational telecom company operating in the wholesale market, engaged in the exploration and marketing of international data circuit capacity and voice across our subsea cables WACS, MONET and SACS, as well as other partnered networks globally.
communityLists.backgroundText2: This page provides a concise overview of the routing policy and the BGP communities used within Angola Cables’ global IP network.
communityLists.contactExpertsKicker: Need help with routing policy or BGP communities?
communityLists.networkItem1: Angola Cables operates a global IP network under ASN 37468 and supports both IPv4 and IPv6.
communityLists.networkItem2: We do not accept RFC 1918, RFC 5735, RFC 6598 or other reserved/private address space advertisements.
communityLists.networkItem3: We reserve the right to disable a BGP peer that harms network stability or customer experience.
communityLists.networkItem4: MD5 authentication is strongly recommended on all BGP sessions.
communityLists.networkItem5: Angola Cables makes no guarantee regarding the routing policies of third-party networks.
communityLists.peeringItem2: Requests should demonstrate a reasonable traffic ratio and operational readiness.
communityLists.peeringItem3: All peering sessions must be established in both IPv4 and IPv6.
communityLists.peeringItem4: Peering candidates should maintain an up-to-date PeeringDB profile and a 24x7 NOC contact.
communityLists.peeringItem5: Requests must be sent to peering@angolacables.co.ao.
communityLists.transitItem1: All customer IPv4/IPv6 prefixes must be registered in an IRR available on the Internet.
communityLists.transitItem2: New prefixes are inserted via ticket or email to the NOC, or through an AS-SET registered in an IRR.
communityLists.transitItem3: Announcements are accepted when they are assigned by Angola Cables, a regional RIR, or another carrier/ISP and are verifiable.
communityLists.transitItem4: Customer prefixes are usually activated within 48 hours after validation.
communityLists.transitItem5: Customers may receive full routing, partial routing, default-only, or full routing plus default.
communityLists.transitItem6: Routing announcements more specific than /24 (IPv4) or /48 (IPv6) are not accepted.
communityLists.transitItem7: The default BGP Local Preference is 300.
communityLists.communityStructureIntro: Angola Cables uses community strings to help identify source relationship, geography and route origin.
communityLists.table.ixpDesc: Routes learned at ANGONIX in Luanda
communityLists.table.partnerDesc: Routes learned from Google in Luanda
communityLists.localPrefText: Used to adjust route preference for customer traffic engineering.
communityLists.exportControlText: Prevents outbound propagation to designated upstreams, regions or IXPs.
communityLists.blackholeText: Used for blackholing specific hosts or address ranges by region.
communityLists.operationalNote1: Angola Cables strips community strings not listed in the official community set.
communityLists.operationalNote2: Customers may use prepend or MED strategies to influence inbound and outbound traffic.
communityLists.operationalNote3: Angola Cables reserves the right to apply traffic engineering via AS-path prepending, MED or communities.
communityLists.operationalNote4: BGP FlowSpec is available on the backbone for customers on demand.

empresa.historia.title: OUR HISTORY
empresa.historia.description: is a multinational telecommunications company that offers advanced global connectivity solutions through a robust infrastructure of submarine cables, data centers and interconnection points.
empresa.timeline.2009: Angola Cables was born from the WACS cable consortium and with it the vision to connect Angola to the world
empresa.timeline.2010: We began construction of the Sangano CLS, an infrastructure milestone with international technical quality
empresa.timeline.2011: We inaugurated the AngoNAP Luanda Data Center in Luanda
empresa.timeline.2012: The WACS cable and AngoNAP began operations, marking the start of our commercial activity
empresa.timeline.2013: We received the Quality and Excellence Award and were present at major industry events
empresa.timeline.2014: We advanced with the ADC Data Center and Monet Cable projects
empresa.timeline.2015: We introduced Angola Cables to Brazil and created the idea of a Technology Hub in Fortaleza
empresa.timeline.2016: The Monet cable arrives in Brazil
empresa.timeline.2017: We began construction of the Fortaleza Data Center and launched the SACS cable
empresa.timeline.2018: We connected 2 continents Americas - Africa with the Monet and SACS cables in operation
empresa.timeline.2019: We certified the Monet CLS with international quality and inaugurated the Fortaleza Data Center
empresa.timeline.2021: We innovated with new digital products and IP variations and Anti_DDoS (layer 7)
empresa.timeline.2022: 3x infrastructure growth We launched Clouds2Africa, Clouds2Brasil and ACeleraNET We opened new PoPs in Singapore and Los Angeles
empresa.timeline.2023:
ISO 27001 Certifications
We reached the goal of 1% of the world's internet on our network
We had an average growth of 22% (EBITDA) over the three-year period
empresa.timeline.2024: Consolidation of our business and operations in subsidiaries in South Africa, Nigeria, Europe/Madeira and USA/Bermuda
empresa.valores.title: VALUES
empresa.valores.missao.title: MISSION
empresa.valores.missao.text: Lead digital connectivity in the South Atlantic and boost the growth of emerging markets.
empresa.valores.visao.title: VISION
empresa.valores.visao.text: Make Angola one of the main Telecommunications Hubs in Africa and accelerate digital transformation in South Atlantic countries.
empresa.valores.paixao.title: Passion
empresa.valores.paixao.text: We value the collective feeling of love for what we do. How each one gets involved for the final result is extremely important for it to reach the level of delivery we aspire to. We are all connected with irreverence, energy and pride in the company and the team. We transform the impossible into reality, because we are passionate about what we do.
empresa.valores.sustentabilidade.title: Sustainability
empresa.valores.sustentabilidade.text: We work thinking about the global impact in the present to sustain the future. Of the company, the businesses, the social and environmental projects, the communities and markets where we operate. We are all connected with the planet and taking care of it is everyone's duty.
empresa.valores.talento.title: Talent
empresa.valores.talento.text: We value the collective feeling of love for what we do. How each one gets involved for the final result is extremely important for it to reach the level of delivery we aspire to. We are all connected with irreverence, energy and pride in the company and the team. We transform the impossible into reality, because we are passionate about what we do.
empresa.valores.eficiencia.title: Efficiency
empresa.valores.eficiencia.text: We are committed to the ethical and objective fulfillment of the organization's procedures and objectives. We manage our tools and resources using the highest standards and certifications to provide superior services to our business partners and customers. Our continuous investment in knowledge development and talent creation are the efficiency engines that fuel our growth and evolution.
equipa.title: OUR TEAM
equipa.description: Our team is here to help you with your business. They work daily so you can achieve your goals and have the best solutions, tailored to your needs and your business.
equipa.angelo_gama.name: ÂNGELO GAMA
equipa.angelo_gama.bio: Ângelo Gama has been CEO of Angola Cables since 2020. He holds a degree in Electrical and Computer Engineering from IST in Lisbon. He began his career as a technical support engineer at HP in Lisbon and has over 21 years of experience in the telecommunications and IT sectors. Throughout his career, he has been involved in major projects such as the launch of the first 3G mobile operator in Europe with Three Mobile in the UK and the HP–Compaq merger, as well as working with Atos Origin in the Netherlands.
equipa.laura_carneiro.name: LAURA CARNEIRO
equipa.laura_carneiro.bio: Laura Carneiro has been an Executive at Angola Cables since 2012, responsible for the Administrative and Financial areas, where she plans, monitors, and defines strategies aligned with the company’s goals. She previously worked at Startel and Mundo Telecomunicações. She holds a degree in Financial Management from the Catholic University of Angola and a course in Strategic Leadership. Laura is recognized for her strong skills in communication, problem-solving, and team leadership.
equipa.rui_faria.name: RUI FARIA
equipa.rui_faria.bio: A manager with more than 25 years of experience in IT, Communication, and Telecommunications, specializing in business strategies, large-scale projects, marketing intelligence, and corporate communication. With a proven track record of delivering impactful programs, he has contributed to the transformation and growth of companies, positioning them as leaders in both national and international markets. Rui has shown competence and integrity in managing human resources, client contracts, and asset returns. Fluent in Portuguese and English, he facilitates international market expansion.
equipa.sergio_pozuelo.name: SERGIO POZUELO
equipa.sergio_pozuelo.bio: Sergio Pozuelo is an international executive with more than 20 years of experience in Sales and Marketing within the Telecommunications and IT sectors. He has worked across Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and Latin America. Graduated in Telecommunications Engineering from the Polytechnic University of Madrid, with an MBA and a Master’s in Marketing, he is Global Commercial Director at Angola Cables. He oversees the company’s subsidiaries in Angola, Brazil, South Africa, Europe, and the USA, leading commercial strategies and driving growth in international markets.
equipa.julio_chilela.name: JÚLIO CHILELA
equipa.julio_chilela.bio: Júlio Chilela is Director of Digital Innovation at Angola Cables and a cloud enthusiast. With vast experience, he led the development of digital platforms and global projects, notably the implementation of Angola’s first public cloud with self-onboarding, spanning 6 regions across 4 countries (Angola, Nigeria, South Africa, and Brazil). He is a PhD candidate in Computer Science at the University of Porto and the University of Houston, focusing his research on 'internet delivery via satellite with 5G and Cloud Core networks'. He also holds a Master’s degree in Geographic Information Technologies from the University of Coimbra.
equipa.artur_mendes.name: ARTUR MENDES
equipa.artur_mendes.bio: Artur Mendes is VP of Sales at Angola Cables with more than 20 years of global telecommunications experience. He joined the company in 2013 after 12 years at Nokia, where he held various roles in Nokia Mobile Phone and Nokia Multimedia Network Terminals. As VP of Sales, he is responsible for global strategy, business development, and managing key client relationships. He has extensive knowledge of major projects such as the Monet and SACS submarine cables and the modernization of Angola Cables’ Data Center in Brazil.
equipa.frederico_oliveira.name: FREDERICO OLIVEIRA
equipa.frederico_oliveira.bio: Frederico Oliveira is Head of Engineering at Angola Cables, specializing in the management and maintenance of IP and submarine networks. With experience in team leadership and collaboration with various suppliers, he ensures the delivery of high-quality solutions. Throughout his career, he has focused on corporate networks, service providers, and telecommunications. He is recognized for persistence, resilience, and adaptability, bringing innovative and proactive approaches to solve challenges in dynamic environments.
equipa.samuel_carvalho.name: SAMUEL CARVALHO
equipa.samuel_carvalho.position: CEO of TelCables Europe & Chief Marketing Officer
equipa.samuel_carvalho.bio: Samuel Carvalho is CMO of Angola Cables. He holds a Master’s in Corporate Communication, a BA in Public Relations and Marketing, and a certification in Transformational Leadership from the Lisbon MBA Program. With more than 18 years of experience in operational and marketing consultancy for the financial sector and FMCG, he has built a solid career in marketing strategies, media, branding, and corporate communication. Under his leadership, Angola Cables launched the 'Global Deep Connection' strategy, promoting services such as CDN, IXP, Cloud Services, Data Centers, and the submarine network connecting Africa to South America.
adriano-caldevilla-bio: Adriano Caldevilla is Chief Technical Officer at Angola Cables. With over 20 years of international experience in networks, submarine cables, cloud, and security, he has worked at global companies such as Zoom, Akamai, Verizon, and Orange. A specialist in critical infrastructure and interconnection, his mission is to strengthen Angola Cables’ position as a global reference in submarine connectivity and international interconnection.
equipa.ariete_pereira.name: ARIETE PEREIRA
equipa.ariete_pereira.bio: Ariete Pereira has more than 10 years of experience in commercial roles in the telecommunications sector and is currently Sales Leader at Angola Cables. She is known for building strong, long-lasting relationships with clients worldwide, providing consistent value and trust through reliable service and strategic partnerships. Committed to generating exceptional value for partners, she ensures her team remains motivated and empowered to drive Angola Cables’ growth in the global telecom market.
equipa.hugo_gomes.name: HUGO GOMES
equipa.hugo_gomes.bio: A management professional with 29 years of experience in IT, technology strategy, consulting, security, solution sales, telecommunications, and business development. With 27 years of experience in Africa, he began his career as a Junior Telecommunications Engineer in 1996 and has held positions such as CTO, Sales and Pre-Sales Director, Country Director, CEO, IT Manager, and Head of Pre-Sales for enterprise systems in two SADC markets.
equipa.fernando_fernandes.name: FERNANDO FERNANDES
equipa.fernando_fernandes.bio: Fernando Fernandes is CEO of TelCables Nigeria & West Africa, a subsidiary of Angola Cables, a global ICT solutions provider and the most connected network operator in Africa. He is responsible for managing, developing, and expanding TelCables operations in Nigeria and the West African region. With broad experience in telecommunications, Fernando is known for his adaptive and innovative leadership, focused on expanding the company’s network and improving service delivery. Appointed CEO in 2023, he has played a key role in consolidating TelCables as a market leader in the region.
equipa.virgilio_alves.name: VIRGÍLIO ALVES
equipa.virgilio_alves.bio: Virgílio Alves has more than 15 years of experience in Customer Experience (CX) and has been Head of Customer Success, Operations, and Channels at Angola Cables for 5 years. Focused on strategic and operational solutions, he strives to enhance the customer experience. With a strong background in telecommunications and mobile operators, he applies a practical, results-oriented approach centered on customer needs. As a member of the Customer Experience Professionals Association (CXPA), he contributes to process, team, and technology transformation to ensure seamless, efficient, and memorable interactions.
equipa.sudhir_juggernath.name: SUDHIR JUGGERNAUTH
equipa.sudhir_juggernath.bio: Sudhir Juggernath is CEO of TelCables Southern & East Africa, a subsidiary of Angola Cables, a global ICT solutions provider and Africa’s most connected network operator. He manages and expands TelCables operations in Southern and Eastern Africa. With 20 years of experience in telecom and technology, he has held strategic roles at Siemens, Neotel, BT Global Services, and Orange, focusing on business development. Appointed CEO in September 2023, he is known for his analytical vision and ability to negotiate and generate market opportunities.
equipa.mahen_mahido.name: MAHEN NAIDU
equipa.mahen_mahido.position: Head of Business Solutions - TelCables South Africa
equipa.mahen_mahido.bio: Telecommunications professional with more than 10 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Product Development, and Pricing Modeling. He stands out for his effective communication and strong client and partner engagement. With an innovative mindset, he always seeks to add value to business requirements. Organized, reliable, and capable of managing multiple priorities with a positive attitude, he demonstrates proactivity and commitment to team goals.
equipa.guilherme_vieira.name: GUILHERME VIEIRA
equipa.guilherme_vieira.bio: With 21 years of experience in national and multinational companies in the ICT sector, 18 of which supporting organizational changes involving complex business processes. He has solid commercial and business development experience gained through extensive negotiations of ICT solutions (software, hardware, and services) across Brazil’s southeast, northeast, south, and midwest regions. Skilled in all phases of the sales cycle for both public and private organizations. Proficient in public and private procurement modalities such as RFI, RFP, RFQ, tenders, auctions, lowest price, technical and price, and framework agreements.

privacy.policies.title: Privacy Policies
privacy.policies.purpose.title: Purpose
privacy.policies.purpose.paragraph1: Angola Cables' (AC) Data Privacy Policy aims to ensure the protection of privacy and the rights of Data Subjects regarding the collection, use, storage, and sharing of their Personally Identifiable Information (PII) in relation to its employees, third parties, and contracts.
privacy.policies.purpose.paragraph2: AC's website collects and uses certain personal data to enable service delivery and improve the user experience.
privacy.policies.scope.title: Purview/Scope
privacy.policies.scope.intro: This Data Privacy Policy applies to all personal data processing activities carried out by AC, including:
privacy.policies.scope.individuals.title: a) Covered Individuals
privacy.policies.scope.individuals.item2: Customers, suppliers, partners, and any third parties who provide data to AC or whose data is processed by AC;
privacy.policies.scope.individuals.item3: Users of AC websites, portals, applications, and other digital platforms.
privacy.policies.scope.dataTypes.title: b) Types of Data Covered
privacy.policies.scope.dataTypes.item1: Personal Data and Sensitive Personal Data, as defined by applicable legislation;
privacy.policies.scope.dataTypes.item2: Personally Identifiable Information (PII) collected through physical or digital means;
privacy.policies.scope.dataTypes.item3: Data obtained directly (provided by the data subject) or indirectly (cookies, logs, internal systems, integrations, etc.)
privacy.policies.scope.activities.title: c) Covered Activities
privacy.policies.scope.activities.intro: This policy covers all stages of the personal data life cycle, including:
privacy.policies.scope.areas.title: d) Covered Areas and Systems
privacy.policies.scope.areas.item1: All directorates/departments, business units and AC subsidiaries;
privacy.policies.scope.areas.item2: Internal systems, databases, IT infrastructures, networks, online platforms, and cloud environments used by AC.
privacy.policies.scope.legislation.title: e) Legislation and Standards Considered
privacy.policies.scope.legislation.conte: This policy is aligned with the laws and regulations applicable in all countries where AC operates, including ISO 27001 and 27701 good practices.
privacy.policies.personalData.title: Personal Data
privacy.policies.personalData.definition: Personal Data refers to any information that can be used to identify an individual, including, but not limited to, a first and last name, a residential address (or other physical address), an email address, or other contact information.
privacy.policies.personalData.commitment: AC recognizes the importance of protecting Personal Data and is committed to processing it lawfully, transparently, and securely. As part of its activities, AC may collect different types of information that identify an individual, whether for service delivery, commercial interaction, professional relationship management, or internal recruitment processes.
privacy.policies.personalData.collection: AC requests personal information when a data subject requests products or services, registers to receive materials, or performs other activities. When visiting AC's website and completing forms, the data subject may provide the following information, depending on the type of form: name, email, phone number, profession, company, city, state. This information will be used to send marketing content and proposals, to subscribe them to our newsletter, or to contact them by phone.
privacy.policies.personalData.jobApplica: For job applicants, AC asks them to provide information such as academic background, professional experience, and career interests.
privacy.policies.otherInfo.title: Other User Information
privacy.policies.otherInfo.content: AC may access technical information about the data subject's browsing activity on the website through cookies and logs, such as IP address, geolocation, referral source, browser type, visit duration, and pages visited.
privacy.policies.dataUse.title: Use of Data
privacy.policies.dataUse.commitment: AC undertakes to use Personal Data responsibly, transparently, and in line with legitimate purposes previously communicated to data subjects. All processing activities are conducted in accordance with the principles of necessity, proportionality, and security, ensuring that the information collected is used only for authorized purposes and within applicable legal limits.
privacy.policies.dataUse.rulesIntro: The specific rules regarding AC's use of Personal Data are set out below:
privacy.policies.dataUse.rule1: All collected data is confidential and for our exclusive use and will not, under any circumstances, be transferred or sold to third parties; therefore, we will not share your Personal Information with third parties without your permission;
privacy.policies.dataUse.rule2: AC may use Personal Information to comply with duly authorized requests for information by government authorities; to comply with any law, regulation, subpoena, or court order; or to help prevent fraud or enforce or protect AC's rights and property;
privacy.policies.dataUse.rule3: The user's email will be used to: send the material or information the data subject requests; send content related to our area of activity; send newsletters, news, events, or other matters that may be of interest to them;
privacy.policies.dataUse.rule4: The data subject may unsubscribe from our mailing list at any time. All emails include an unsubscribe link in the last lines. By clicking this link, the data subject is automatically removed from the list. This website collects information from its visitors not only by asking specific questions, but also by enabling communication via email and forms.
privacy.policies.analytics.title: Google Analytics
privacy.policies.analytics.intro: The website uses Google Analytics features, including marketing and demographic reporting. AC uses this information to:
privacy.policies.analytics.purpose1: help make the website easier to use;
privacy.policies.analytics.purpose2: help users quickly find information, products, and services;
privacy.policies.analytics.purpose3: help create and present content that is more relevant to users and alert them about new products and services offered by the company.

privacy.policies.consent.title: Consent
privacy.policies.consent.definition: AC processes personal data based on the data subject's consent. Consent is the free, informed, and unequivocal expression through which the data subject authorizes AC to process their data.
privacy.policies.consent.agreement: By using AC's services and providing their personal data, the data subject acknowledges and agrees to the provisions of this Privacy Policy and understands their rights and how to exercise them.
privacy.policies.consent.withdrawal: At any time and at no cost, the data subject may withdraw their consent. It is important to note that withdrawing consent for data processing may make it impossible to properly perform certain website functionality that depends on that processing. Such consequences will be communicated in advance.
privacy.policies.retention.title: Data Retention Period
privacy.policies.retention.content: Personal data collected by AC will be used and stored for as long as necessary to provide the service or to achieve the purposes set out in this policy, taking into account the rights of data subjects and controllers.
privacy.policies.sharing.title: Data Sharing
privacy.policies.sharing.links: The AC website may contain links to other websites. Our privacy policy does not apply to third-party websites; if you visit another website from ours, you should read that website's privacy policy. We are not responsible for the privacy policy or content on those websites.
privacy.policies.sharing.recipients: Recipients receive the data only to the extent necessary to provide the contracted services, and our contracts are guided by data protection rules under Brazilian law and all other jurisdictions where we operate.
privacy.policies.sharing.otherSituations: In addition, there are other situations in which data may be shared, namely:
privacy.policies.sharing.situation1: Legal determination, request, requisition, or court order, with competent judicial, administrative, or governmental authorities;
privacy.policies.sharing.situation2: Corporate transactions, such as merger, acquisition, or incorporation, automatically;
privacy.policies.sharing.situation3: Protection of AC's rights in any type of dispute, including judicial disputes.
privacy.policies.cookies.title: Browsing Data (Cookies)
privacy.policies.cookies.definition: AC uses Cookies, which are text files sent by the platform to the computer, where they are stored, containing information related to browsing the website. In short, Cookies are used to improve the overall user experience.
privacy.policies.cookies.acceptance: By accessing our website and consenting to the use of Cookies, the data subject acknowledges and accepts the use of a system that collects browsing data through Cookies on their device.
privacy.policies.cookies.control: At any time and at no cost, the data subject may change permissions, block or refuse Cookies. However, withdrawing consent for certain Cookies may prevent some platform features from functioning correctly.
privacy.policies.changes.title: Changes to the Privacy Policy
privacy.policies.changes.right: AC reserves the right to modify this policy at any time, especially to reflect any changes made to its website or legislative changes. Any changes will take effect from their publication on our website.
privacy.policies.changes.consent: By using our services and providing personal data after such modifications, the data subject consents. This Privacy Policy may be updated at any time. Therefore, AC recommends periodically accessing the Privacy page. AC is committed to keeping this policy up to date, observing its provisions and ensuring compliance. In addition, it undertakes to seek technical and organizational measures that are reliably capable of protecting the entire data processing operation.
privacy.policies.disclaimer.title: Disclaimer
privacy.policies.disclaimer.intro: AC adopts high security standards to prevent incidents; no online page is entirely risk-free. In this regard, AC is not responsible for:
privacy.policies.disclaimer.responsibili: any consequences arising from users' negligence, imprudence, or lack of expertise regarding their own individual data. AC is responsible only for the security of data processing procedures and for meeting the purposes described in this instrument. We emphasize that responsibility for the confidentiality of access credentials lies with the user;

malicious actions by third parties, such as hacker attacks, except where culpable or deliberate conduct by AC is proven. We emphasize that in the event of security incidents that may generate relevant risk or harm to the data subject or any of our users/clients, we will notify those affected and the relevant regulatory agencies.
privacy.policies.dpo.title: Data Protection Officer (DPO)
privacy.policies.dpo.content: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or about the personal data we process, the user may contact the Personal Data Protection Officer via email: dpo@angolacables.com, and will be referred to AC's Legal Office (GJU).

policies.bcm.title: Business Continuity Policy
policies.bcm.objective.title: Objective
policies_bcm_objective_intro: The Business Continuity Management Policy aims to:
policies_bcm_objective_a: Protect employees and assets by mitigating, in disaster situations, risks to the physical safety of people and assets;
policies_bcm_objective_b: Control, prevent, limit impact and ensure recovery capability from disruptive incidents and potential disasters that may affect AC’s operations, image, and reputation;
policies_bcm_objective_c: Effectively safeguard the business by establishing recovery mechanisms that ensure the continuity of AC’s critical business processes;
policies_bcm_objective_d: Preserve the interests of stakeholders, the quality of services provided, and the satisfaction of customers and partners, thereby increasing their confidence;
policies_bcm_objective_e: Continuously comply with international best practices, recommendations, and/or legal and regulatory requirements;
policies_bcm_objective_f: Ensure that Business Continuity risks are identified, understood, monitored, and mitigated to an acceptable level for AC;
policies_bcm_objective_g: Enable AC to manage Business Continuity effectively and efficiently across its processes, in line with best practices and business strategic guidelines;
policies_bcm_scope_p1: This policy provides the general rules and principles for the proper implementation and maintenance of AC’s Business Continuity Management System (BCMS).
policies_bcm_scope_p2: The scope covers the BCMS and all its components (regulations, plans) and assets (infrastructure, processes, applications, services, people, and technology), ensuring operational continuity and mitigation of risks associated with disruptive events.
policies_bcm_scope_p3: This policy is also based on international best practices and applicable standards in the field of Business Continuity.
policies_bcm_principles_intro: Within the scope of Business Continuity Management, and in order to achieve the defined objectives, AC shall:
policies_bcm_principles_a: Analyze the internal and external context, ensuring an adequate understanding of the organization, the business, as well as its risks and opportunities.
policies_bcm_principles_b: Define a hierarchical structure with clearly assigned roles and responsibilities throughout the entire BCMS lifecycle, considering both pre- and post-disaster phases;
policies_bcm_principles_c: Ensure that the processes supporting operations and business activities are identified;
policies_bcm_principles_d: Analyze the impact of process disruptions over time and determine recovery priorities for these processes and their supporting resources (e.g., facilities, employees, applications, suppliers);
policies_bcm_principles_e: Assess the exposure of critical processes to risks and events that may compromise their continuity due to the unavailability of supporting resources and means;
policies_bcm_principles_f: Define and implement a Business Continuity (BC) strategy to reduce the likelihood of disruptive incidents and potential disasters and, if they occur, recover processes within defined timeframes, ensuring continuity at acceptable minimum levels through the implementation of prevention, response, and recovery plans, procedures, and measures (technical and organizational);
policies_bcm_principles_g: Include and integrate critical or relevant service providers into the aforementioned BC strategy, as well as monitor their resilience capabilities by assessing the measures they implement to respond to disruptive events;
policies_bcm_principles_h: Integrate the Incident Management process within the scope of the Business Continuity Management System;
policies_bcm_principles_i: Develop, implement, and monitor the effectiveness of plans and measures, ensuring continuous improvement through regular testing, performance indicators, audits, and periodic reviews by responsible teams and top management;
policies_bcm_principles_j: Embed a Business Continuity culture across the organization through regular training and awareness initiatives, ensuring all employees understand their responsibilities;
policies_bcm_principles_k: Establish, maintain, and continuously improve the Business Continuity Management System, ensuring periodic updates of all supporting documentation and the relevance and adequacy of the information contained therein;
policies_bcm_principles_l: Ensure, from the initial stage, that Business Continuity considerations are properly addressed in all relevant and impactful projects for AC;
policies_bcm_principles_m: Ensure that the BCMS addresses Information Security Continuity requirements;
policies_bcm_principles_n: Promote compliance with legal and regulatory requirements related to Business Continuity.
procurement.policy.title: Procurement and Supplier Relationship Policy
procurement.objective.title: 1. Objective
procurement.objective.paragraph1: This policy aims to establish the principles, guidelines, responsibilities and procedures applicable to the acquisition of goods and contracting of services, setting forth the regulations for its execution process while ensuring requirements of competitiveness, quality, safety, socio-environmental responsibility of acquired goods and the continuous improvement of the relationship with AC's suppliers and service providers.
procurement.objective.itemA: Ensure the integrity, transparency and traceability of contracting processes;
procurement.objective.itemB: Promote competition under equal conditions among suppliers;
procurement.objective.itemC: Ensure selection based on objective, technical and economic criteria;
procurement.objective.itemD: Guarantee segregation of duties in operational and decision-making phases;
procurement.objective.itemE: Ensure compliance with applicable legal, regulatory and internal standards;
procurement.objective.itemF: Promote ethical, responsible and sustainable practices in the supply chain;
procurement.objective.itemG: Ensure adequate use and protection of supplier data;
procurement.objective.itemI: Respect the principles of the Code of Ethics and Conduct, internal standards and comply with legislation applicable to its activities;
procurement.objective.itemJ: Ensure timely payment of contracted goods and services.
procurement.scope.title: 2. Scope
procurement.scope.paragraph1: This policy establishes the normative framework applicable to the processes of acquiring goods, contracting services and managing AC's suppliers and service providers, ensuring that they are conducted with integrity, transparency and aligned with best practices in governance, internal control and risk management.
procurement.scope.paragraph2: The policy applies to all areas and organizational units of AC involved in contracting processes, as well as to all suppliers, service providers and partners who establish contractual or commercial relationships with AC.
procurement.supplierRelationship.title: 3. Relationship with Suppliers and Service Providers
procurement.supplierRelationship.paragra: AC values a transparent, honest and partnership-based relationship with its suppliers, service providers and partners, and therefore establishes ethical professional relationships free from favoritism.

Therefore, those who are currently AC suppliers, or wish to become one, must pay attention to the criteria to be followed and be aware that they may be evaluated throughout their supply cycle, and must provide information when requested.

AC intends that its suppliers and third parties be more than providers of materials, services and equipment, but rather partners for sustainable development and a strong culture of integrity in the business environment. To this end, it has established a relationship model with its suppliers based on the commitment to follow good practices and internationally recognized principles. This model was inspired by recognizing the importance of the economic, environmental and social impacts produced by this stakeholder group, and is guided by two main axes:
procurement.supplierRelationship.eixo1: • AC's Code of Ethics and Conduct, which determines, among other aspects, that the supplier evaluation and selection process is carried out rigorously and following the highest standards of transparency and ethics;
procurement.supplierRelationship.eixo2: • A set of supplier relationship principles of AC, which describes the minimum requirements, for both suppliers and AC, regarding business practices, occupational health and safety, ethics and environmental management.
procurement.communicationChannel.title: 4. Communication Channel
procurement.communicationChannel.paragra: In this context, it is essential that any person, whether employee, supplier or service provider, reports any acts or suspicions of non-compliance with this Policy, preventing acts of fraud and corruption and preserving AC's image.
Irregularities may be reported in writing and submitted through the following channel: https://portal-de-denuncias.vercel.app/ or by email denuncias@angolacables.com
customer.dueDiligence.policy.title: Policy on the Identification, Acceptance and Due Diligence of Customers and Partners
customer.dueDiligence.objective.title: 1. Objective
customer.dueDiligence.objective.paragrap: This policy forms part of Angola Cables' (AC) internal control and risk management system, aligning with the best practices of the Programme for the Prevention and Combating of Money Laundering, Terrorist Financing and the Proliferation of Weapons of Mass Destruction (PC-BC/FTP), as well as with the principles and rules established under the Anti-Bribery Policy.

Its purpose is to establish the rules, guidelines and criteria applicable to the process of identifying, understanding, accepting and monitoring customers and partners, as well as, where applicable, their legal representatives and beneficial owners, ensuring that all business relationships are established on the basis of adequate, verifiable information consistent with the required standards of integrity, transparency and compliance.
customer.dueDiligence.scope.title: 2. Scope
customer.dueDiligence.scope.paragraph1: In the context of AC's activities, the application of this policy aims not only to mitigate the risks associated with money laundering and terrorist financing, but also to prevent exposure to risks of bribery, corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest and other practices that may compromise the legality, reputation and sustainability of the business relationships established.
customer.dueDiligence.scope.paragraph2: To this end, risk-proportionate due diligence mechanisms are defined, which enable the assessment of customers' suitability, an understanding of the nature of their business, the origin of funds and the framework of commercial relationships, ensuring that these are compatible with the applicable legal, regulatory and internal requirements.
customer.dueDiligence.scope.paragraph3: This policy applies to all employees, members of the governing bodies and all organisational units of AC, and is mandatory in the context of establishing, maintaining and reviewing any business relationships, regardless of the channel, geography or nature of the services provided.
